title: Citizen’s Charter
description: The city’s published reference for service requirements, processes, fees and timelines.
caution: Large PDF · about 28 MB, 1,193 pages. Selected resident-service sections have been reviewed; this is not a review of every section. The document library links directly to relevant pages.

title: City budget reports
description: Find the city’s financial reports and budget ordinances in the official document index.
caution: An index of published records; completeness has not been assessed.

title: Financial Report of Operations
description: A direct link to the report listed by the city for the period ending September 30, 2026.
caution: Image-based PDF. Figures have not been transcribed or analyzed by Better Pasay.

title: Full disclosure reports
description: Browse the city’s disclosure index by report type, year and quarter.
caution: Some listed records may not have an accessible attachment.

title: Bid opportunities
description: View the city’s published procurement opportunities and associated documents.
caution: Check the original posting for deadlines and amendments.

title: Award notices
description: Find notices about the award of city procurement contracts.
caution: An award notice does not establish contract completion or payment.

title: Ordinances & resolutions
description: Explore the City Secretariat’s legislative record portal, linked from the official city website.
caution: Separate city-linked domain. Confirm the text and status of any individual measure.

title: Client satisfaction report
description: Read the city’s report on service feedback, including its scope and methodology.
caution: Published by the city; Better Pasay has not independently audited the survey.
